steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thach Nhan, an earth element stone golem, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: crouching over the food; (3) EAT: crunching it with stone jaws; (4) EAT: chewing, pebble crumbs falling. Row 2: (5) EAT: patting its stone belly, satisfied; (6) PLAY: curling into a boulder; (7) PLAY: rolling as a boulder; (8) PLAY: a heavy hop. Row 3: (9) PLAY: ground pound with both fists; (10) PLAY: dust cloud landing; (11) PLAY: flexing its stone arms; (12) REFUSE food: turning its back, arms crossed. Row 4: (13) PETTED: moss blooming on its head, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a heavy stone hand; (15) SAD: sitting, cracks dimming; (16) ANGRY: cracks glowing red, fists clenched.
